key_insight: RadiomicNet combines handcrafted radiomics with a lightweight segmentation network to improve interpretability while maintaining strong medical image segmentation performance.
clinical_relevance: This could help clinicians get more transparent, texture-aware segmentation outputs with fewer parameters and potentially more reliable predictions.
method: Radiomics Attention Gate using GLCM and LBP features
Radiomics Consistency Loss to align texture complexity with uncertainty
evidence_signal: Reported Dice scores were 0.763 ± 0.231 on BUSI and 0.854 ± 0.112 on Kvasir-SEG, with fewer parameters than U-Net and U-KAN and improved ECE.
watch_item: Results come from specific datasets and should be validated more broadly before assuming the same performance and interpretability in other clinical settings.
paper_title: RadiomicNet: A Hybrid Radiomics-Guided Lightweight Architecture for Interpretable Medical Image Segmentation
